items.q: In the Schwartz equation, the constant K for a term infant under 1 year (age not mentioned) is:
items.exp: <1 yr: pre-term 0.33, term 0.45 (if age not mentioned). (Book p736)

items.q: Match each child group with its Schwartz constant K — 1) Pre-term <1 yr 2) Term <1 yr 3) 1–2 yr and adolescent girls 4) Adolescent boys … A) 0.45 B) 0.33 C) 0.7 D) 0.55
items.exp: K: pre-term 0.33; term 0.45; 1–2 yr & adolescent girls 0.55; adolescent boys 0.7. (Book p736)

items.q: Fill up: The Schwartz equation computes eGFR as K × the child's ______ divided by S.Cr.
items.exp: eGFR = K × length of child / S.Cr. (Book p736)
